Hi, I help organize the SF Lean meetup: https://sflean.group/

Our members give presentations on Lean-related topics every week and we post the videos online, here's some of the past talks on our youtube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@sflean

Was thinking the Lean Zulip would be a good place to link these videos. What would be the right channel to post in?
@Adi Baradwaj #Geographic locality > San Francisco Bay Area, USA is maybe the best place
